title: Lion's Mane Mushroom Capsules - 1000MG
body:
Cognitive Clarity & Nervous System Support

Lion’s Mane Mushroom Capsules are formulated to support long-term brain health and mental clarity. Known for its nootropic properties, Lion’s Mane contains bioactive compounds—like hericenones and erinacines—that may help stimulate the growth of nerve cells and support cognitive resilience.

Traditionally used in Eastern medicine, Lion’s Mane is celebrated for its ability to promote memory, focus, and overall nervous system health. It may also help support mood and reduce mental fatigue, making it an ideal daily supplement for clarity and calm energy without the need for stimulants.

It contains no artificial additives and is ideal for those looking to support their brain and body naturally through plant-based compounds.*

 

🌿 Key Benefits of Lion’s Mane

  • Supports focus, memory, and mental clarity through naturally occurring nootropics

  • Encourages healthy nerve growth factor (NGF) activity for long-term brain support

  • May help reduce brain fog and promote calm, balanced energy

  • Traditionally used to support mood and cognitive resilience*

Ingredients: Organic Lion’s Mane (Hericum erinaceus) Mushroom Fruiting Body & Mycelium Powder (Standardized to 40% polysaccharides [400mg]), Organic capsule (pullulan, water), organic pea starch.

Vegan, Vegetarian, Non-GMO, Gluten Free, Lactose Free

Manufacturer Country: USA

Product Amount: 60 vegan capsules

Gross Weight: 0.2lb (90g)

Suggested Use: As a dietary supplement, adults take two (2) capsules daily or as directed by a health care professional. Can be taken with food or on an empty stomach.

Warning: Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if the safety seal is damaged or missing. Store in a cool, dry place.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
